settings.heading: How these cost figures are produced
settings.intro_fact: Every formula, every source and every fetch date. Rated power is present for 47 of 139 priced saunas — 33.8% — after reading 142 manufacturer manuals and 3,569 pages, and the 66.2% that is missing is the most important number on this page.
settings.collection_label: The 139 priced saunas these figures cover
settings.dataset_name: InHouse Wellness home sauna cost tables
settings.dataset_description: Purchase price, delivery tier, rated power and state electricity rate for 139 priced home saunas, each figure carrying its source and fetch date. Rated power is present for 47; the remaining 92 are recorded as absent rather than estimated.
